purpose: Retained rejected ordinary Vector source-controller composition experiment. RESULTS.md owns these evidence files; retain or archive them with that experiment.
selection: rejected: three qualified scalar suffix-3 useful-cell losses

native_inputs.source_identity_result: All relevant native sources, headers and build-rule bytes match the retained base source manifest exactly. The original link command and object order are retained; only the WF object and output image differ.

correctness_phase: The correctness record was frozen before timing; its timing_executed:false field describes that phase only.
paired_method: Seven samples per variant/cell/cohort. Compare candidate and control Whitefoot observed ranges: gain iff candidate maximum < control minimum, loss iff candidate minimum > control maximum in both cohorts, otherwise overlap. Qualify only if every paired Whitefoot sample is >= 1000000 ns and 100*(max cohort median ratio/min cohort median ratio-1) <= 10. Preserve six suffix-0 cells as unranked. No rows removed. No native-drift rescaling.
original_screen_recommendation_preserved: Stop before correctness/timing under the preregistered comparable-hot-spills refusal: ordinary truncate is followed by seven Q-pair reloads on each nonempty outer cycle. This is a code-screen recommendation, not a measured performance loss.
continuation_reason: Before linking/checks/timing, root and independent review treated comparable hot spills as ambiguous: the candidate retains seven pair reloads per nonempty cycle but removes repeated 14 ADRP, 14 Q literal loads, seven pair stores and wide tail call/frame. The prospectively committed continuation compares complete repeated setup; all correctness, no-loss, target, duration and stability criteria remain unchanged.

linked_inspection.method: Compare every unrelocated instruction byte; separately verify WF/local branch relocations. Resolve stripped local helper addresses from the adjacent preserved global anchor and require actual branch targets to agree. Only weak floor_run resolves to the frozen strong runtime definition.

reproduction: At source_revision build ordinary gate-profile whitefootc with --locked --offline --bin whitefootc --jobs 2 under .github/run-check.pl. Use a whole git archive to freeze all source/module inputs, apply source-controller-composition.patch with patch -p1 -F 0, check and emit vector-library.wf. Apply existing Makefile main/allocator substitutions, compile ordinary -O3 LLVM and reuse exact native peer/runtime object inputs/order in native_inputs.link_commands. Run all twelve execution commands, then only if newly authorized run control and candidate measure 1048576 7. CSV-only reductions use ../summarize-ecosystem.pl --complete and --targets plus paired_method; this does not reproduce historical execution.

portable_path_prefixes.${SOURCE_CONTROLLER_SCRATCH}: Disposable experiment directory containing the archived source snapshot, frozen compiler, candidate, screen, continuation and timing outputs.
portable_path_prefixes.${CHECKOUT}: Isolated working checkout of this PR, used only as the origin when inputs were frozen.

path_encoding: Expand each documented portable prefix to its local directory before replaying an argv. This changes path spelling only; raw scratch identities and every file digest remain unchanged.
paired_csv_publication: The derived paired CSV uses LF line endings in the repository. Raw scratch reducer bytes retain CRLF; all parsed fields are identical. Timed sample files are copied unchanged.
